rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Dora (hybrid tea, Gaujard 1975)
rows.Bloom: Orange or orange-red. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Notes: For clarification about parentage, see References... Modern Roses 10 says 'Rubens' is the pollen parent, but doesn't say which 'Rubens'.
